findings.statement: noteSearchText() speculatively matches note.title, a field that does not exist in the wire contract (Note serializes only id/text). Documented as a future-field hedge; harmless and not dangerous, but it is an un-oracled speculative branch.
findings.evidence: web/app.js:353-360 'if (note && note.title != null) parts.push(String(note.title))' with the comment 'The API only exposes text today, but title is included so a future field keeps working.' main.go:66-70 Note struct has json tags only for id/text; TestUISemantics does not pin title behaviour.

findings.statement: The re-stamped edge-case list dropped the non-ASCII q examples that the pre-base spec listed (emoji q=%E2%9C%93, Cyrillic q=%D0%BC%D0%BE%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%BA%D0%BE); TestNotesSearchEncoding now covers only ASCII %/space/&/+ cases, so non-ASCII query handling has no named oracle. The implementation is Unicode-safe, so all 30 matrix rows C-01..C-30 remain oracled; this is a coverage-note, not a contract gap.
findings.evidence: Diff of the 'Negative and edge cases' section: old line enumerated 'q=a%26b%2Bc, q=%E2%9C%93, q=%D0%BC%D0%BE%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%BA%D0%BE'; new line 80 lists only 'q=100%25, q=%26, q=a%2Bb, q=%20' -> TestNotesSearchEncoding. main.go:538/543 uses strings.ToLower + strings.Contains (Unicode-safe, no panic path); no test sends a non-ASCII q.

findings.statement: shot() writes scenario screenshots relative to process.cwd(), so running the Playwright suite from any directory other than the repo root would create evidence in the wrong place. Pre-existing pattern (the branch diff only switches full-page capture to element/state capture, adds a toBeVisible() guard, and moves the SEARCH-E2E-6 shot before the clear); no functional impact.
findings.evidence: web/e2e/notes-search.spec.js:116-123: 'const dir = path.join(process.cwd(), "doc", "идеи", "f-v4-note-search", "screenshots")'; new: 'const target = locator || page.locator(".card.notes"); await expect(target).toBeVisible(); await target.screenshot({ path: ..., animations: "disabled" })'; SEARCH-E2E-6 shot moved to lines 279-280 (before clearQuery) to capture the search-empty state.
